title: Corrosion-Resistant Steel Latch Hooks at the Fwd Cargo Door

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: First improvement of the forward cargo door latching, replacing the cadmium-plated carbon steel hooks by a corrosion-resistant steel item with a nitrided bearing face, in answer to hook seizure reports from humid operating environments.

sections.reason: Between 2014 and 2016 operators in tropical and coastal networks reported eleven cases of a forward cargo door latch hook binding on its shaft, three of which prevented the door from being closed and produced an aircraft-on-ground event. Teardown showed the cadmium plating on the original carbon steel hook breaking down at the bearing face, allowing corrosion products to build up in the running clearance. The hook material, not the geometry, was identified as the driver at the time.
sections.description: The eight latch hooks of the forward cargo door are replaced by corrosion-resistant steel items with a nitrided bearing face and an increased running clearance of 0.15 mm. The forward latching intercostal sub-assembly D5230133201099 is retained but the hook shaft bores are reamed 0.2 mm oversize and fitted with a thin-wall bush. The forward latching strap ZEL623186-50 is replaced by a thicker item to carry the revised bush seating. Shear head bolts AGS773887-1B are used at the hook shaft retention. The door is not removed; the work is done through the door aperture in zone 891 and from the compartment side in zone 892. Revised detail is on drawing D52301387215.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 1.6 kg per aircraft. No electrical load change. The new hook is not interchangeable with the original because the shaft bore is reamed oversize and the bush is not removable in service; a mixed hook set on one door is not permitted. The lubrication task at the hook shaft moves from an A-check to a C-check interval. The IPC latching figure requires a pre and post effectivity split, and the door rigging check in the AMM requires a revised clearance value.
sections.embodiment_note: Retrofit only, through Service Bulletin SLN-52-1024, which has since been cancelled and replaced. The change was overtaken by the load-sharing arrangement of the follow-on modification before it reached production cut-in.

type_data.balance_impact: Forward of the reference datum; effect below the reporting threshold
